facts.name: SBScooterShared_UpdateNearestTarget(shared)
facts.note: The coordinator tick's target search: FindNearestFreeScooter over the block's own list from the party leader, the dormant point removal, then AssignObject into shared+0. Same shape in both builds; 1.005 reads the scooter fields at +0x2338/+0x233A (the +0x20 move).

facts.name: SBScooterCoordinator_TryBeginRide's idle-branch call of PartyManager_ResolveFieldLeaderCharOrLeader(1) (the marker's character)
facts.note: 1.004 E8 D5 61 80 FF at %16=2, 1.005 E8 C3 AC 8D FF at %16=0, both inside one block; the next instructions (mov rdx,rax; lea r9,[rsp+30h]; mov r8b,1: the CanAutoRideTarget call) match. The rider's resolve later in the function (1.004 0x14125A63D, 1.005 0x140E89338) is another site.
